description: Special tutorial designed to provide Chemistry 11 background.
supplementalNotes:
• For students intending to enrol, either simultaneously or subsequently, in an university-level introductory general chemistry course.
  • 0.5 fee unit.
  • This course is delivered online.
  • There are no set class times; a unit should be completed roughly every two weeks during the term. Students are assessed by timed on-line quizzes after the completion of each unit.
title: Introduction to Basic Chemical Concepts
